title: Working at Oslo's Metropole Hotel despite the American Consul
summary: He found a singing job at the Metropole Hotel the first night, got no help from the American Consul, and obtained working papers from the German consul, playing for sunk-ship crews.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: And so, I looked for some friends. I couldn't find any friends, I couldn't find them because, it was night.
So, I got a room in a hotel/on---- and the next day, I went to the American Consulate. I went to the American Consulate and he says well, I -- by the way, I had gotten a job that night.
Right in the hotel next door, called the Metropole Hotel, singing 'Sonny Boy.' I Sonney Boyed them right away. Tails and all.
So, he says, 'How did you get here?' That's what the American Consulate told me. 'How did you get here?'
I says, well, I was in occupied, I was in occupied Holland, I was in occupied Belgium, so -- help me to get home.

He said, man, why don't you catch one of these freighters or tankers or something out of here? I said, but they are sinking like matchboxes out there/on the North Sea, he said -- well, he got so nervous and everything and frantic, I left and took that, I said, I think I better go back where this come from. I took that stamp, that pass, and went to the

German Consul.
He called it a Norwegian and said, give him working papers. He said you go and ask -- and start working, feel good.
Don't worry about nothing; He said, / you go on
I went and started working and about a week after that --
The Metropole. It was a big hotel.
And that, about a week after that, you know, they sunk a ship up there -- I'm not sure, I don't know which one it was. They sunk it up there.* The Allies caught it up there.
And about a week -- the crew from that ship was "Dein ist mein notzt Hertz"... in the Metropole and I put (inaudible) on them too. And -- it was my job.
Now, they was still, they hadn't decided to do nothing to Norway so I stayed there about eleven months.
